authoredNote: Names and lines transcribed from a measured run and checked against the fixture source.
rationale: H5 and H6 (reviews/hcl/master-review.md). A flat attribute map is a legitimate HCL document — a `*.tfvars` file is nothing else, and `language-detection.ts:47` routes `.tf`/`.tfvars`/`.tofu`/`.hcl` all to this analyzer. The attribute branch was guarded `if (key && blockPath.length > 0)`, and a top-level attribute has no enclosing block, so every one was dropped: 126 corpus files with real content produced ZERO symbols (consul's `full-config.hcl` with 30+ top-level attributes, `boundary/enos/enos.vars.hcl`, nomad's `sample2.hcl`). The second half is H6: the analyzer emitted no document root, so the containment graph was a forest with no trunk — unlike the JSON/YAML/SQL/XML convention — and every top-level item was ownerless. The root is a `module` named from the file stem, and every non-root symbol now carries an `ownerName`.
forbidSymbolsNote: An object literal's inner keys (enabled, tokens, master, deep, deeper) are DATA, not declarations: only the top-level attribute of a flat document is a symbol. Listed as forbidden names above.
